Kinesis Advantage 360 Pro

Layer map

Generated from config/adv360.keymap — what is drawn here is what gets flashed. Hover a key for its raw binding. Print for a one-page-per-layer reference.

Brackets are combos

Left hand opens, right hand closes, and the row picks the pair. Press both keys together with one flattened index finger.

R + T(top row Y + U)top row F + G[home row H + J]home row V + B{bottom row N + M}bottom row

The inner columns beside T and Y are dead on purpose. They used to hold [ and ]; leaving them bound would give the brackets a second route, and a second route is what stops a habit forming.

Sticky modifiers

Every key with a dot is sticky: tap it, then press the key it applies to. No holding.

They use quick-release, so the modifier drops on the next key press rather than its release — tap shift and type abc at speed and you get Abc, not ABC.

They still work held. Hold sticky Cmd and tap Tab repeatedly and the app switcher walks as normal; quick-release only applies once the key has been tapped and released.

Two of them chain: tap Ctrl, tap Shift, press T and you get Ctrl+Shift+T. Untouched after a second, they expire.

Regenerate with ./tools/keymap-page.py after editing config/adv360.keymap, and commit what changes.
